item.description:
Title: This Is Me
Artist: Charlee
Genre: Pop Rock
Release Date: December 24, 2011

Tracklist:
1. This Is Now
2. What Is She (Compared to Me)
3. Lass Mich Gehen (Zum Glück...) feat. Orry Jackson
4. When You Sleep
5. I Couldn't Sleep
6. Someone Like You

This was an EP released as a limited time download on her website featuring unreleased songs from her past years and a cover of "Someone Like You" by Adele.
